info.title: batsim
info.description: Residential battery fleet simulator: physics-faithful virtual homes behind an OpenAPI-first HTTP API for dispatch-strategy testing (ERCOT).

101.description: WebSocket upgrade; JSON tick and dispatch messages

duration_s.description:
Hold duration in seconds; the home returns to
self-consumption afterwards. Omit to hold indefinitely.

Hold duration in seconds; the home returns to
self-consumption afterwards. Omit to hold indefinitely.

soc.description: Reserve as a fraction of usable energy (0..1).

pct.description: Curtailed fraction of output in percent (0..100).

oneOf.description:
Clear all overrides: self-consumption mode, no setpoint, no
curtailment.

ActionSpec.description: The dispatch action. Closed union, discriminated by `type`.

amplitude_c.description: Half peak-to-peak swing in deg C.

mean_c.description: Daily mean temperature in deg C.

ArchetypeEntry.description: One weighted archetype entry in a fleet manifest.

model_id.description: Battery model id from the device catalog.

request_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical request body.

fleet_id.description: Fleet to attach the home to (must exist when given).

initial_soc.description: Initial state of charge (fraction of usable; default 0.5).

oneOf.description:
Inverter selection (optional; vendor default composed when
omitted).

command_id.description:
Client-supplied command id (ULID/uuid). Retries with the same id
are deduplicated before enqueue. Server-assigned when omitted.

oneOf.description:
Per-device execution latency; each home draws its own delay,
mimicking a vendor cloud API. Default uniform 250..2000 ms.

count.description: Additional homes to create from the fleet's manifest.

FleetAgg.description: Fleet aggregation across homes per bucket.

FleetDispatchRequest.description: Fleet dispatch body: a dispatch request without the target.

expansion_hash.description: Content hash of the expansion (verification of determinism).

manifest.description: The manifest the fleet was created from.

FleetManifest.description: Fleet manifest: archetype x count x load-zone distribution.

seed.description:
Expansion seed; re-applying the same manifest yields identical
homes.

HomeConfigDoc.description: Echo of a home's configuration as validated and defaulted.

controller_model_id.description: Composed controller model id, when any.

inverter_model_id.description: Composed inverter model id, when any.

pv_peak_kw.description: Resolved PV peak in kW, when PV is present.

soc.description: Mean state of charge across battery units.

oneOf.description: PV array (optional; `peak_kw` may be a uniform range).

InverterSpec.description: Inverter selection; omitted means "compose the vendor default".

model_id.description: Inverter model id from the device catalog.

rated_ac_output_kw.description: Rated continuous AC output in kW.

KwDraw.description: A fixed value in kW, or a uniform range over (0, 100].

annual_kwh.description:
Target annual consumption in kWh; scales the archetype's floor
area heuristically when present.

anyOf.description:
Climate zone: IECC-style (`2A`, `3A`, `3B`, `4A`) or a Texas zone
name (`gulf_coast`, `central`, `north`, `west`). Default `central`.

OkDoc.description: Empty success body for action endpoints with nothing to return.

OperatingMode.description: Operating modes a home can be commanded into.

OutageSpec.description:
A scheduled outage window. Recorded with the scenario; outage physics
(grid loss, islanding) is applied once the resilience milestone ships.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when exhausted.

reserve_soc.description: New backup reserve floor (fraction of usable).

oneOf.description: A single flat price for the whole run.

price_per_mwh.description: Price in $/MWh applied at every tick.

seed.description: Seed reserved for stochastic profile extensions.

oneOf.description:
Historical replay. Not available yet; activating a scenario with
this source fails validation until replay data support lands.

date_range.description: Inclusive date range (ISO 8601 dates) to replay.

market.description: Market (only the real-time market is modeled).

PriceSourceSpec.description: Where settlement prices come from for a scenario.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem document; the only error body the API emits.

instance.description: The request path that produced the problem.

peak_kw.description:
Array DC nameplate in kW (a fixed value, or a uniform range in
fleet templates).

ScenarioDoc.description: Scenario document: the binding plus identity and lifecycle.

seed.description: Scenario seed; governs every random draw during the run.
Scenario seed; governs every random draw during the run.

start.description: Run start (RFC 3339 UTC; must be 5-minute aligned).

achieved_speed.description: Measured speed over the recent window.

active_scenario.description: Id of the active scenario, if any.

lag_ticks.description: Ticks the scheduler is behind (must return to 0 after bursts).

speed.description: Configured speed multiplier (0 = as fast as possible).

multiplier.description: Sim-seconds per wall-second; 0 = as fast as possible.

applied_kw.description: Applied power in kW measured at execution.

requested_kw.description: Requested power in kW for power actions.

oneOf.description: Execution status; null while still queued.

mode.description: Only homes in one of these modes.

soc_gt.description: Only homes with SOC strictly above this fraction.

TargetSpec.description: Dispatch target set: a fleet id, explicit home ids, or both.

oneOf.description: Historical weather replay. Not available yet.
